newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S JMM INVESTMENT CHANGES NAME TO CITADEL.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S JMM INVESTMENT CHANGES NAME TO CITADEL.

text.p: JMM Investment Services announced on Thursday it had changed its name to Citadel Investment Services.
The independent portfolio manager, which focuses on the high income bracket of the market, has funds under supervision of about 700 million rand.

It combines accounting, legal, actuarial and economic forecasting skills to provide life-time investment advice to a client base of about 900 people with portfolios varying in size from 500,000 rand to 15 million rand.
